items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: He told me, down at the Overseas Club, don't you remember me, Snub, I played with you.

ctx.x: Maybe he did play with your band.
He might have played with my band, but I don't remember it. He told me, down at the Overseas Club, don't you remember me, Snub, I played with you.
